$comment: Known real builds of the 350Z (BUILD_PROMPT 6.5), all on Z Car Garage's Dynojet in San Jose with STD correction: one dyno, one shop, several cars. Chosen before running the model (docs/research-notes/part2b.md). Excluded: supercharged cars (boost not printed), cam builds, SuperFlow and Dyno Dynamics sheets whose values were read off small images, and owner-reported figures without sheets. Research: docs/research/part2b/known-builds-nissan-350z-z33.json.

builds.title: Stock 2003 350Z (VQ35DE, 287 hp)

sources.title: Z Car Blog (Z Car Garage, San Jose): "Rick's 350z" (13 Jul 2018)
sources.note: He's pined for a 350z and finally got a 2003 model waiting to be modified. ... We set him up with the tried/true combo: JWT pop charger, Motordyne 5/16 plenum spacer, Bassani cat-back exhaust and UPREV flash. ... On the dyno the mods alone produced gains of 11hp/2tq to the wheels over baseline
